experiment_data.hypothesis: Pretrained N-scaling: CoNLL N=32 with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (unfinetuned). CoNLL pretrained showed strong MV gain (+9.2pp at N=8). Tests whether this advantage scales with N, and whether the pretrained-vs-finetuned contrast (direction flip) persists at higher sample budget. Addresses reviewer concern about generalization.
